Example risk of bias datasets

rob_datasets.Rd

Fictional risk of bias assessments for each supported tool. Each "study" is a film character, with the character's surname as Author and the film's release year as Year:

Usage

rob2_data

robins_i_data

robins_e_data

quadas2_data

clarity_data

rob_nma_data

probast_data

probast_ai_data

rob2_sq_data

Format

Tibbles with one row per study:

Author

Character surname, used as the study label.

Year

Release year of the film.

Subgroup

Subgroup (rob2_data and probast_ai_data only).

weight

Study weight, summing to 1 (not in rob_nma_data, probast_data or probast_ai_data).

D1, D2, ...

Domain judgements. See rob_plot() for the domains of each tool.

R1-R3

ROBIS domain judgements (rob_nma_data only).

A1-A3

Applicability judgements (probast_data and probast_ai_data only).

Conclusions

Concerns about the authors' conclusions (rob_nma_data only).

Source

Fictional data for illustration.

Details

  • rob2_data: RoB 2 for individually randomised parallel-group trials, characters played by Anne Hathaway, with Subgroup by genre.

  • clarity_data: CLARITY (all 12 domains), characters played by Anne Hathaway. Includes cluster (D11) and cluster crossover (D12) trials; these domains are NA for other trials.

  • robins_i_data: ROBINS-I V2, characters played by Bill Murray.

  • robins_e_data: ROBINS-E, characters played by Bill Murray.

  • quadas2_data: QUADAS-2, characters played by Adam Sandler.

  • rob_nma_data: RoB NMA with ROBIS domains 1-3, characters played by Adam Sandler.

  • probast_data: PROBAST, characters played by Emily Blunt.

  • probast_ai_data: PROBAST+AI, characters played by Emily Blunt, with Subgroup separating model development and evaluation.

  • rob2_sq_data: answers to the RoB 2 signalling questions for 7 trials (characters played by Anne Hathaway): 3 parallel-group, 2 cluster-randomised and 2 crossover trials, with design giving the design. Columns are named as in the cribsheets (1.1, 1b.1, 2.1a, ..., S.3), with the crossover questions S.1-S.3 last. Questions skipped by the algorithm are NA. Use with rob2_algorithm().

Overall judgements are not included (except Conclusions in rob_nma_data), so they are derived by rob_plot() and rob_summary(), or by rob2_algorithm() for rob2_sq_data.

Examples

rob_plot(rob2_data, add_rob_legend = TRUE)

rob_summary(robins_i_data, weight = weight, rob_tool = "robins_i")


rob2_sq_data |>
  rob2_algorithm(design = design) |>
  rob_plot(add_rob_legend = TRUE)
